integrity: One analytic theorem with explicit conditional-tail constant and moment boundary, accompanied by reproducible finite arithmetic and Monte Carlo checks; no claims of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact unit-disk and iid angular-uniform law at each fixed integer n>=3. No n-uniform tail error, noise stability, or arbitrary convex body analogue proved. Complete 2015 primary paper not accessible for priority comparison.
title: A sharp Pareto area law for bounded random circle-circumscribing polygons
